headline: Chip Stock Pullback Drags Asia-Pacific Markets; Straits Times Index Falls 0.13% on Wednesday
summary: Chip stocks plunged on Tuesday, and rebounds lost momentum on Wednesday, leaving most Asia-Pacific markets lower. The Straits Times Index fell 0.13%, as investors awaited US CPI data.
why: The Straits Times Index tracks Singapore's largest listed companies, and regional markets are sensitive to global chip and AI-related valuations.

impacts.name: Straits Times Index
impacts.why: The index fell 0.13% on Wednesday as rebounds in chip stocks lost momentum across Asia-Pacific markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Chip stocks had plunged the previous day, and the rebound faded as investors awaited US inflation data and reassessed valuations of AI-related stocks.
